body.statement: For the fixed origin constraint, the Brownian--GCM likelihood-ratio functional \(D(0)\) in \(\texttt{def:canonical-field}\) is a finite nonnegative random variable almost surely.

source.locator: Section 2, definition of the limiting likelihood-ratio functional and the fixed-location limit theorem
source.verbatim_statement: The limiting distribution is that of the integral of the difference of the squared slope processes

upstream.citation: Banerjee, M. and Wellner, J. A. (2001), Likelihood Ratio Tests for Monotone Functions, Annals of Statistics 29(6), 1699-1731, DOI 10.1214/aos/1015345959

attestation.note: Lawful author-hosted PDF at University of Washington, checked 2026-09-14; abstract and pp. 1699-1701, including equation (1.2). The citation is used only for the proper fixed-location LR limit variable, not growing-domain excursions.
